context: A small-cap component maker's stock has doubled in three weeks after a viral social-media post. Revenue grew just 2% last quarter, versus 20% the year before, and the P/E is 60 against a sector average of 18.

block.question: Given only what you can see, is the risk here skewed to the downside, upside, or roughly balanced?
block.factorQuestion: Which of these support that read?

factorOptions.label: Revenue growth has slowed sharply while the price has doubled
The P/E is far above the sector average with no fundamental improvement to justify it
The stock is getting a lot of social-media attention
